parsed.study_design: Cross-sectional face-to-face questionnaire survey with descriptive statistics and multivariable logistic regression
parsed.population_and_sample: 1,000 residents of all ages sampled across Emfuleni, Lesedi and Midvaal municipalities in Sedibeng District Municipality
parsed.exposure: Perceptions of municipal governance and service dissatisfaction, including corruption, financial management, councillor responsiveness, civic engagement and dissatisfaction with water provision
parsed.outcome: Individual participation in service-delivery protests; service-specific satisfaction ratings were secondary descriptive measures
parsed.rationale: The methods and Table 6 (pp. 13–19) identify protest participation as the dependent outcome, with dissatisfaction about water provision and governance perceptions treated as predictors. Although the survey reports general satisfaction with water and sanitation-related services (Table 4 and Sect. 4.3), it does not report a sufficiently specific household water or sanitation access, connection, availability, reliability, quantity, affordability or exclusion outcome linked to the governance exposure; therefore it fails criterion 4.
